fixed_point_quantizer.scope: hidden state only; frozen H separator retained in float64

dtype_quantizer.scope: hidden state and frozen H separator coefficients

usable: the exact H wait-specific separator exists, all scores are finite, accuracy is 1.0, and normalized geometric margin is strictly positive after representation

classification.robust_state: every configured representation has the same usable wait window as float64 for every task
classification.immediate_loss: a task has no usable wait beyond the configured immediate_loss_wait_max in every modest representation
classification.precision_fragile: float64 has usable information and at least one configured representation loses usable waits
